prompt: Which correctly calls the parent constructor from a subclass?
choices: class Truck extends Vehicle { Truck(int axles) { Vehicle(axles); } }
class Truck extends Vehicle { Truck(int axles) { super(axles); } }
class Truck extends Vehicle { Truck(int axles) { this.Vehicle(axles); } }
class Truck extends Vehicle { Truck(int axles) { new Vehicle(axles); } }
explanation: super(args) invokes the parent constructor and must be the first statement. Option A tries to call Vehicle() as a method (invalid). Option C uses this.Vehicle() (invalid syntax). Option D creates a new Vehicle object but doesn't initialize the Truck properly.
